Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Compressor operation in Normal mode.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Compressor operation in Normal mode.
initial_conditions: - Compressor Circuit Breaker is not tripped (IO2_C1_IS_COMP_CB = 0)
- Compressor cotactor is not manually switched off
- Compressor Isolation Valve is Open (IO1_C1_IS_COMP_OFF = 0 and IO2_C1_IS_COMP_NO_OFF = 1)

test_actions.text:
In Car-C1:
- Manually reduce the air pressure below PM_MIN_PRESSURE

Read Pressure value and pressure switch signal, 
When decreases under 8.3 bars, pressure switch signal changes
Compressor Starts and Main pipe pressure increases gradually.

In Car-C1:
- Wait for the Main Pipe pressure to increase above PM_MAX_PRESSURE

Read Pressure value and pressure switch signal, 
When increases over 9.8 bars, pressure switch signal changes
Compressor Stops.

In Car-C1:
- Manually reduce the air pressure between PM_MIN_PRESSURE and PM_MAX_PRESSURE
Nothing happens.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Forced start of Compressor
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Forced start of Compressor

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
 - Insert the Maintence Key and rotate the switch.
Maintenance mode is activated.

On HMI:
- Navigate to Maintenace Control Screen and press the virtual pushbutton for Forced Compressor Start.
Compressor Started.

On HMI:
- Press the virtual pushbutton for Forced Compressor Start again.
(Note: This step is to be performed after Main Pipe pressure reaches 10 bar, with the safety valve opened.)
Compressor Stops.

In Car-C1:
- Manually reduce the air pressure between PM_MIN_PRESSURE and PM_MAX_PRESSURE
Nothing happens.

On HMI:
- Navigate to Maintenace Control Screen and press the virtual pushbutton for Forced Compressor Start.
Compressor Started.

On HMI:
- Press the virtual pushbutton for Forced Compressor Start again.
(Note: This step is to be performed before Main Pipe pressure reaches PM_MAX_PRESSURE.)
Nothing happens.

In Car-C1:
- Wait until the pressure reaches PM_MAX_PRESSURE.
Compressor Stops.

In CABIN:
 - Rotate the Maintenace switch and remove the key.
Maintenance mode is de-activated.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the failures related to circuit breaker tripping
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the failures related to circuit breaker tripping

test_actions.text:
In Car-C1:

Check Alarm

In Car-C1:

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the failures related to Compressor function
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the failures related to Compressor function

test_actions.text:
In Car-C1:
- Pneumatically isolate the Compressor
Check Inputs
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Remove the Compressor Isolation Valve Cable 86120.28 from TB XT73.171: 03
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Re-connect back the Compressor Isolation Valve Cable 86120.28 into the TB XT73.171: 03
Alarms Reset.
- Reset the pneumatic isolation of the Compressor.
Alarms Reset.

In Car-C1:
- Deactivate the Compressor Control Contactor 60K01 by removing cable from its terminal A1
Nothing happens

In Car-C1:
- Manually reduce the air pressure below PM_MIN_PRESSURE
Compressor does not start.
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Re-connect the cable in terminal A1 of the Compressor Control Contactor 60K01.
Compressor starts & Alarm Reset.

In Car-C1:
- Wait for the Compressor to Stop.

In Car-C1:
- Mechanically force the Contactor 60K01 power contacts
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Keep the Contactor 60K01 power contacts forced for more than 5 minutes.
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Unforce the Contactor 60K01 power contacts
Alarms Reset.

In Car-C1:
- Manually reduce the air pressure below PM_MIN_PRESSURE
Compressor starts.

In Car-C1:
- Remove the Air Dryer Cables 86120.25 and 86120.29 from TB XT73.171: 03
- Wait for 3 min with the compressor on.
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Re-connect the cables 86120.25 and 86120.29 in the TB XT73.171: 03
Alarm Reset.

In Car-C1:
- Remove the MRP Pressure Transducer sensor Cable 60151.01 from TB XT73.181: 12
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Re-connect the MRP Pressure Transducer sensor Cable 60151.01 in the TB XT73.181: 12
Alarm Reset.

In Car-C1:
- By using an 1.5sq.mm external cable, create a shorting link between TB XT14.113: 04b and XT14.113: 06b
- Manually reduce the air pressure below PM_MIN_PRESSURE
Compressor starts.
Check Alarm

In Car-C1:
- Wait for Compressor to Stop automatically.
- Remove the 1.5sq.mm external cable between TB XT14.113: 04b and XT14.113: 06b
Alarm Reset.
DELETED
DELETED

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the opening of Coupler cover & Coupler extension in normal scenario.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the opening of Coupler cover & Coupler extension in normal scenario.
initial_conditions: - Forward direction is selected in enabled cabin

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Coupling System Open"
Coupler Cover is opened and Coupler is extended in below sequence:
1. Coupler Cover opened. Check Inputs.
2. Coupler folding joints starts unlocking. Check Inputs
3. Coupler starts unfolding (extending). Check Inputs
4. Coupler folding joints starts locking. Check Inputs

To check the Coupler retraction & closing of Coupler cover in normal scenario.
initial_conditions: - Forward direction is selected in enabled cabin
- Coupler Cover is Open and Coupler is in extended position.

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Coupling System Close"
Coupler is retracted back and Cover is closed in below sequence:

2. Coupler starts folding (retracting). Check Inputs
3. Coupler folding joints starts locking. Check Inputs
4. Coupler Cover closed. Check Inputs

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the failures of Coupling Circuit
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the failures of Coupling Circuit

test_actions.text:
In CAR:
- Connect external Laptop to 86A05
- Using AUNIA tool, force the input I_S_COVER_OPND = 1
- Wait for > 2s.
Check Alarm

In CAR:
- Using AUNIA tool, Unforce the input I_S_COVER_OPND
Alarm Reset.

In CAR:
- Remove the cable 62160.05 from TB XT14.113: 05a.
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Open Cover"
- Wait for > 10s.
Check Alarm

In CAR:
- Re-connect back the cable 62160.05 in the TB XT14.113: 05a.
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Open Cover"
Alarm Reset & Coupler Cover is Opened.

In CAR:
- Remove the cable 62160.06 from TB XT14.113: 05a.
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Close Cover"
- Wait for > 10s.
Check Alarm

In CAR:
- Re-connect back the cable 62160.06 in the TB XT14.113: 05a.
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Close Cover"
Alarm Reset & Coupler Cover is Closed.

In CAR:
- Connect external Laptop to 86A05
- Using AUNIA tool, force the input I_S_UNLOCKED_COUP = 1
- Wait for > 2s.
Check Alarm

In CAR:
- Using AUNIA tool, Unforce the input I_S_UNLOCKED_COUP
Alarm Reset.

In CAR:
- Connect external Laptop to 86A05
- Using AUNIA tool, force the input I_S_UNFOLDED_COUP = 1
- Wait for > 2s.
Check Alarm

In CAR:
- Using AUNIA tool, Unforce the input I_S_UNFOLDED_COUP
Alarm Reset.

In CAR:
- Remove the Cable from Relay terminal 62K13: A1
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Coupling System Open"
- Wait for > 15s.
Check Alarm

In CAR:
- Reconnect back the Cable in the Relay terminal 62K13: A1
Alarm Reset

In CAR:
- Remove the Cable from Relay terminal 62K14: A1
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Coupling System Open"
- Wait for > 15s.
Coupler is extended but not locked.
Check Alarm

In CAR:
- Reconnect back the Cable in the Relay terminal 62K14: A1
Alarm Reset.
Coupler remain extended and Unlocked.

In CAR:
- Remove the Cable from Relay terminal 62K11: A1
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Coupling System Close"
- Wait for > 10s.

Coupler remain extended and unlocked
Check Alarm

In CAR:
- Re-connect back the Cable in the Relay terminal 62K11: A1
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Coupling System Close"
Alarm Reset & Coupler is retracted back.

In CAR:
- Remove the Cable from Relay terminal 62K12: A1
- On HMI, press the virtual pushbutton command "Coupling System Open"
- Wait for > 10s.

Coupler remain closed and unlocked
Check Alarm

In CAR:
- Reconnect back the Cable in the Relay terminal 62K12: A1
Alarm Reset.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To verify the manual application of Sanding- C1, FWD Direction
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To verify the manual application of Sanding- C1, FWD Direction
initial_conditions: - Forward Direction selected from Active Cab.
- Traction Brake Handle in COASTING position.
- TCMS Communincation with TCU & BCU is OK.
- Sufficient Track Length available for vehicle movement.

test_actions.text: STEP DELETED

In CABIN:
- Press Sanding pushbutton (63S01) mounted on the hand rail.

Sanding activated for <PM_AX_SAND_PB_STOP_TIME> seconds.
(on 1st axle & 5th axle)
Check Inputs and Flow meter of corresponding axles.
Check that Sandbox Ventillation remained activated for next 10s after Sand demand has ceased.

In CABIN:
- Press Sanding pushbutton (63S01) again before less than <PM_AX_SAND_CONSECUTIVE_TIME> seconds from the last application.
Nothing happens.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for Sanding.

Sanding activated for <PM_AX_SAND_TEST_TIME> seconds.
(on 1st axle & 5th axle)

In UNDERFRAME:
- Press Sand Test pushbutton (63S03)

Sanding activated as long as button is pressed.
(on 1st axle & 2nd axle)
Check Inputs and Flow meter of corresponding axles.

In CABIN:
- Gradually shift the Traction Brake Handle in TRACTION position & maintain vehicle speed > 3Kmph.
Nothing happens.

In CABIN:
- Press Sanding pushbutton (63S01) mounted on the hand rail.

Sanding activated continuously as long as button is pressed.
(on 1st axle & 5th axle)

In CABIN:
- Release Sanding pushbutton (63S01) mounted on the hand rail.
- Apply Emergency Brake from Traction Brake Handle

Sanding activated continuously as long as Traction Brake Handle in EB position and vehicle speed > 3Kmph.
(on 1st axle & 5th axle)

In CABIN:
- Apply Service Braking and gradually stop the vehicle.
Sanding deactivated.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To verify Wheel Flange Lubrication function in normal operation.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To verify Wheel Flange Lubrication function in normal operation.
initial_conditions: - Forward Direction selected from Active Cab.
- Traction Brake Handle in COASTING position.
- Sufficient Track Length available for vehicle movement.

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- Gradually shift the Traction Brake Handle in TRACTION position & maintain vehicle speed > 10Kmph.
Wheel Flange Lubrication activated based on travelled distance.

Check Variable: O_WHEEL_FLA_ON = 1
for PM_FL_WL_GREASING_TIME seconds after every 500m distance travelled.

In CABIN:
- Apply Service Braking and gradually stop the vehicle.
Wheel Flange Lubrication de-activated.
Check Variable

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To perform Wheel Flange Lubrication Test
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To perform Wheel Flange Lubrication Test

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton "Test Wheel Flange Lubrication" in Maintenance command screen.

Cyclic application of Wheel Flange Lubrication lasts for PM_FL_WL_TEST_SPRAY_CYCLES cycles.
. Physically verify the application of Lubricant on wheel flange surface.

Check Variable: O_WHEEL_FLA_ON = 1 for  PM_FL_WL_GREASING_TIME s  
Thereafter O_WHEEL_FLA_ON = 0 for PM_FL_WL_BLOCKING_TIME s. 
After PM_FL_WL_TEST_SPRAY_CYCLES cycles  O_WHEEL_FLA_ON=0 always.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton "Test Wheel Flange Lubrication", and press it again before the PM_FL_WL_TEST_SPRAY_CYCLES cycle in Maintenance command screen.
Test stops

Test_Cases.name:

To verify the WFL Lubricant level diagnostic
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To verify the WFL Lubricant level diagnostic

test_actions.text:
In Car:
- Manually remove the lubricant from the WFL Grease reservoir.
Check Alarm

In Car:
- Manually re-fill the lubricant in the WFL Grease reservoir.
Alarm Reset

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To perform Top of Rail Lubrication Test
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To perform Top of Rail Lubrication Test

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton "Test Wheel TOR Lubrication" in Maintenance command screen.
Cyclic application of Top of Rail Lubrication lasts for PM_FL_TOR_TEST_TIME seconds on both sides. Physically verify the application of Lubricant on rail surface.

Check Variable: 
O_TOR_ON = 1 for 1s
O_TOR_RIGHT_ON = 1 for 1s  Thereafter
O_TOR_ON = 0 for 1s
O_TOR_RIGHT_ON = 0 for 1s 
After 3s total time, 
O_TOR_ON = 0 always
O_TOR_RIGHT_ON = 0 always

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton "Test Wheel TOR Lubrication" and press it again before PM_FL_TOR_TEST_TIME.
Tests stops
